Container.Name: Media Manager
Container.Overview: Configure and run MediaValidator with a guided web setup page.
Container.Requires: ClamAV, Radarr, and Sonarr must be running separately. Mount the same media files in Media Manager and ClamAV. VPN Guard is optional and needs the Docker socket mount.

Config.Name: Setup UI Port
Config.Description: Unraid host port for the setup page.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Persistent settings and validator history. Keep this mapping during updates.

Config.Name: Docker socket (VPN Guard)
Config.Description: Pre-filled for VPN Guard to list containers and stop the ones you select. Remove this path if you do not want Media Manager to control containers.

Config.Name: Media Data Root
Config.Description: Common host folder containing Downloads/Complete and Quarantine. Keep both under this mount for hardlinks; change to your existing data share.

Config.Name: Web UI Password
Config.Description: Required password for the setup page. Username is admin.
